Duel.title: Duel
Duel.intro: Choose what to play next by putting your games face to face, two at a time, until one is left.
Duel.loading: Getting your games ready for the duel
Duel.signInFirst: Sign in to put your own games face to face.
Duel.failed: Your games couldn’t be read. Check your connection and try again.

pick.title: Choose the contenders
pick.drawSize: Draw up to {count} games at random
pick.full: A duel holds 16 games at most. Take one out to add another.
pick.count: {count, plural, =0 {No games} one {# game} other {# games}}
pick.duels: {count, plural, =0 {no duels} one {# duel} other {# duels}}
pick.needMore: Choose at least two games, or draw some at random.
pick.none: No games with these statuses. Choose another above.
pick.matches: {count, plural, =0 {No games match} one {# game matches} other {# games match}}
pick.kept: {count, plural, one {A game in your last duel left your shelf, so it ended. The other one is still chosen.} other {A game in your last duel left your shelf, so it ended. The other # are still chosen.}}

empty.title: Nothing to put face to face yet
empty.body: A duel is drawn from the games you mean to play: your backlog, someday and wishlist. Add a few to your shelf, and come back to choose between them.
empty.unsorted: {count, plural, one {Your shelf has # game with no status yet.} other {Your shelf has # games with no status yet.}} Say where each stands in Organize, and the ones you mean to play can duel.

fight.progress: {played} of {total, plural, one {# duel} other {# duels}} played
fight.question: Which would you rather play next?
fight.leaveBody: The duels played so far will be lost. The games stay chosen.

value.lengthLong: about {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
value.lengthRangeLong: {low, number} to {high, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
value.scoreLong: {rating, number} out of 100 on IGDB, from {count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}}

champion.label: Your next game
champion.beat: {count, plural, one {Won its one duel, against {games}.} other {Won all # of its duels, against {games}.}}
champion.started: {title} is now Playing on your shelf.
champion.failed: {title} couldn’t be set to Playing. Try again.
